lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (2) to back flange (3) fold, about 90 deg. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% and along the whole line in 0.5 mm steps, the line sits on the outer rounded apex within +/-0.05 mm and runs parallel to the fold. It covers the fold from corner radius to corner radius, t about 0.3 to 49.7 of 50.0 mm; the fold ends at the lapped box corners. The two extruded hole collars in the flange are not bends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate (2) to right flange (4) fold, about 91 deg. The line is on the outer apex within 0.03 mm from t about 3 mm to the B1 corner, and covers the whole real fold. Small overshoot: the first ~2.7 mm (v -27.7 to -25) runs over a relief slit, where the flange tail is cut free from the plate. There is no fold there, and the line sits ~0.7 mm from the square plate edge. That is under 1 mm and only 5.6% of the line, so not counted as wrong extent.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Plate (2) to left flange (7) fold, about 90 deg. The line is on the outer apex within 0.04 mm from t about 1.5 mm to the B1 corner (t 25). The first ~1.5 mm runs over the end of the relief slit, with offset about 0.65 mm. The fold only joins plate and flange from v about -3.2 to the corner, so the line covers 100% of it. Beyond the slit (v -8.7 to -3.2) the flange tab is detached from the plate, so there is no fold to label there.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Plate (2) to notch-edge flange (10) fold, about 89 deg. The line is on the outer apex within 0.05 mm from the plate's bottom edge to the inner end of the notch. Past t=20.9 the plate carries on flat, so the fold ends where the line ends. The flange's height step (about 11 to 7 mm) is an edge profile, not a bend.
